title: Religion's Fear: Freedom Feels Like Terror #shorts

top_liked.author: @gilsonsangulukaniphiri5018
top_liked.text: Religion is about control and manipulation.

top_liked.author: @gabrielbrawley
top_liked.text: Yeah. I understand this. I tried hard to make myself believe. I thought if I could fake it long enough I would eventually make it. I was wrong. I'm happier as an honest atheist.

top_liked.author: @tiburd7
top_liked.text: The proliferation of religion is also facilitated by some people's demand for exactly what it offers:  a celestial parent substitute that keeps an adult in a perpetual child state, looking to the parent for security and willing to "follow their rules" in exchange.
